title: EKS Document Base Schema - Definitions
description: Document metadata, structural element definitions, shared enums for document type, file type, element type codes, lifecycle stages, and column processing metadata per T1.35. v1.20.0 (I291 T1.254): document_element_def shape enriched (id UUID PK, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), optional element_seq) and 2 declared_only relations added to registry_relations (fk_element_doc doc_id→documents.id; fk_element_type element_type→element_type.element_type) — materialized in `_eks_table_relations`, no physical DuckDB FK DDL (I290 precedent: doc_id FK would block _migrate_ids_to_uuid; element_type target unmaterialized). v1.19.0 (I290 T1.253): added project_code to project_metadata_def and a schema-declared `document_registry_relations` list (GROUP 11 runtime documents table) — FK relationships (document_type→project_doc_type composite (project_code,local_code), discipline, file_type, project_code, self-ref supersedes/superseded_by) declared as schema metadata consumed by SchemaToDDL; runtime registry does not emit DuckDB FK constraints to un-materialized definition-layer tables (DuckDB rejects FK to missing table & blocks PK update referenced by self-FK on UUID migration) — relations persisted as `_eks_table_relations` manifest + validated at the validation layer. v1.18.0 (I286 T1.237): column_processing_entry_def extended with optional manual_review boolean (default false) — data-source classification flag: true = Manual-source column requiring human input (Phase 5 verification), false/absent = derivable column (still review-allowed). v1.17.0 (I283 T1.230): element_type_code extended 8→11 — added title_block, grid, signature_block for the four-level Class→Type→Template→Element detection model (complete Phase 1 drawing-frame profiles). v1.16.0 (I280 T1.218): B3.2 sub-object defs added — structural_profile_def + extraction_profile_ref/retrieval_profile_ref/validation_profile_ref + Phase 3 stubs (document_semantics_def, ai_profile_def, knowledge_relationships_def), all OPTIONAL fields on document_class_def/document_type_def (absent = use defaults; extraction ref resolves to eks_processing_config.json extraction_profiles ids per I281). v1.15.0 (I281 T1.223): parsing_profile_def REMOVED. v1.14.0 (I282 T1.226): document_type_concept_def REMOVED — replaced by shape-only document_class_def, document_type_def, document_family_def (class_id/type_id/family_id plain strings — NO value enums; VALUES live in eks_document_type_schema.json#/document_classes, #/document_types, #/document_family per SSOT §9/§16 + I031 precedent). ontology_class relaxed from enum to plain string (validated at runtime against eks_ontology_config.json). project_document_type_def and document_type_entry_def migrate concept_id→class_id. document_type_code enum kept as a derived mirror of the union of all local_code values in eks_document_type_schema.json#/project_document_types. v1.13.0 (I276 T1.206): document_type_entry_def extended with default_parsing_profile (two-axis parser routing projection). v1.12.0 (I275 T1.203): column_processing_entry_def extended with applies_to_document_types + native_only scope keys. v1.11.0 (I279 T1.214): added document_type_concept_def, project_document_type_def, document_template_entry_def — defs backing the three-section eks_document_type_schema.json v2.0.0 carrier. document_type_code enum is a derived mirror of the union of all local_code values in eks_document_type_schema.json#/project_document_types. v1.10.0 (T1.195): added parsing_profile_def — named parser profile with declared capabilities (supported_extensions, supported_document_profiles, requires_ocr, extraction_methods) for capability-driven L.13.6 validation (V2). v1.9.0 (I264): added 6 column-processing definitions — column_type_enum, processing_phase_enum, calculation_strategy_def, handler_def, validation_rule_def, column_processing_entry_def. v1.8.0: T1.99.157–158 (I193) — added x_export boolean flag to every property in document_metadata_def and project_metadata_def; added export_artifact_def enumerating 3 export artifacts (discovery_inventory, extraction_results, review_flags) with schema-driven column subsets. v1.7.0: T1.99.150 (I186) — doc_id_format changed from '{doc_number}-{revision}' pattern to UUID v4 pattern; id is now system-generated, not business-key-derived. v1.6.0: added lifecycle_stage_code enum + 15 new optional columns in document_metadata_def for document metadata completeness (T1.99.141–T1.99.146): supersedes, superseded_by, document_title, lifecycle_stage, revision_date, revision_description, embedded_revision_number, references_documents, project_phase, contract_package, issued_date, responsible_engineer, total_sheets, language, vendor_name. v1.5.0 was bypassed (combined into v1.6.0). v1.4.0: added file_property_source_def, file_property_pattern_def, file_property_os_def + 13 new optional columns in document_metadata_def for Appendix J FilePropertyExtractor (T1.99.128). v1.3.0: added filename_pattern_def, filename_segment_def, filename_output_def, filename_error_subcodes_def for Appendix I FilenameParser (T1.99.111). v1.15.0 (I281 T1.223): REMOVED parsing_profile_def — superseded by core eks_base_schema.json extraction_profile_def (one-time migration, Q1). Extraction/parsing profile values now live in eks_processing_config.json#/extraction_profiles (SSOT §9). Core schemas are the sole profile source.

doc_id_format.description: Document identifier format: UUID v4 (system-generated). T1.99.150 (I186) changed from '{doc_number}-{revision}' business key to pure UUID.

document_type_code.description: Document type codes aligned with ontology document_type_mapping (Appendix C) and TWRP assets.

file_type_code.description: Source file format codes aligned with TWRP parsers and pipeline parsers config.

element_type_code.description: Structural element types per Appendix D D7.10. I283 (T1.230): extended 8→11 — added title_block, grid, signature_block so Phase 1 document profiles cover the drawing-frame capabilities declared in structural_profile (Drawing class).

revision_id.description: Document revision identifier. Validation patterns defined in doc config (revision_validation).

lifecycle_stage_code.description: Document lifecycle stage codes per engineering document control workflow. T1.99.143.

ontology_class.description: Ontology class for graph mapping. I282: plain string validated at runtime against eks_ontology_config.json (no value enum — SSOT §9/§16).

class_id.description: I282: document class this code belongs to (projection from project_document_types via class_id)

template.description: I279: template_id from document_templates this code uses (projection)

format_category.description: I279: native vs PDF-print delivery format (projection)

native_source.description: I279: native source extension when format_category is print (projection)

expected_file_types.description: File extensions expected for this document type

default_parsing_profile.description: I276: default parsing profile id for two-axis routing (projection from project_document_types)

structural_profile.description: I280 (T1.220): B3.2 structural profile projected for this document type (type-level override, falling back to class-level). Absent = class/type defaults.

document_class_def.description: Document class registry entry (I282 B3.1 three-level hierarchy — Level 1). Shape-only definition — the class_id VALUES live in the carrier eks_document_type_schema.json#/document_classes (SSOT §9/§16 + I031 precedent; base holds shape only, no value enums). I280 (T1.218): optional B3.2 sub-objects — structural_profile (class-level defaults), extraction_profile_ref/retrieval_profile_ref/validation_profile_ref (profile refs), Phase 3 stubs (document_semantics/ai_profile/knowledge_relationships). Absent = use defaults.

class_id.description: Document class identifier (e.g. Drawing, Specification, Datasheet, Calculation, Manual, Register, Report, Procedure). Validated at runtime against the carrier document_classes registry.

ontology_class.description: Ontology class for graph mapping. Plain string — validated at runtime against eks_ontology_config.json

common_rules.description: Class-level common processing rules shared across project bindings

structural_profile.description: I280: B3.2 structural characteristics for the whole class (class-level defaults; types may override)

extraction_profile_ref.description: I280: default extraction profile id for this class (resolves to eks_processing_config.json extraction_profiles)

retrieval_profile_ref.description: I280: Phase 2/3 — default retrieval profile id

validation_profile_ref.description: I280: default validation profile id (I284 feeds the column-value layer)

ai_profile.description: I280: Phase 3 stub — AI reasoning behaviour

knowledge_relationships.description: I280: Phase 3 stub — typed relation registry

document_type_def.description: Document type registry entry (I282 B3.1 three-level hierarchy — Level 2). Shape-only definition — the type_id VALUES live in the carrier eks_document_type_schema.json#/document_types. A type belongs to exactly one class and optionally one family. I280 (T1.218): optional B3.2 sub-objects — type-level structural_profile/ref overrides; absent = inherit class-level defaults.

type_id.description: Document type identifier (e.g. P&ID, Isometric, Loop Drawing). Validated at runtime against the carrier document_types registry.

class_id.description: Reference to a class_id in the carrier document_classes registry

family_id.description: Optional reference to a family_id in the carrier document_family registry. Null when the type belongs to no family.

structural_profile.description: I280: B3.2 structural characteristics override for this type; absent = inherit class-level structural_profile

extraction_profile_ref.description: I280: extraction profile id override for this type

retrieval_profile_ref.description: I280: Phase 2/3 — retrieval profile id override

document_family_def.description: Document family registry entry (I282 B3.1 three-level hierarchy — Level 3, cross-discipline grouping). Shape-only definition — the family_id VALUES live in the carrier eks_document_type_schema.json#/document_family. A family is a sub-discipline grouping whose members share common properties and activities (D6).

family_id.description: Document family identifier (e.g. Process Drawing, Instrument Drawing). Validated at runtime against the carrier document_family registry.

discipline.description: Engineering discipline this family groups under

project_document_type_def.description: Per-project document-type binding (I279 three-section carrier). Binds a project-local code to a document class and a template. Different projects may use different local codes for the same class. I282: concept_id migrated to class_id (concept layer removed).

local_code.description: Project-local document type code (stored in document_metadata_def.document_type)

class_id.description: Reference to a class_id in the carrier document_classes registry (validated at runtime)

template.description: Reference to a template_id in document_templates

format_category.description: Native format (dwg/dgn/docx/xlsx) vs PDF print of the same document

native_source.description: Native source file extension (e.g. dwg, docx) when the binding is a print of a native file

expected_file_types.description: File extensions accepted for this binding

default_parsing_profile.description: Default parsing profile id for this binding (I276)

document_template_entry_def.description: Structural template registry entry (I279 three-section carrier). Defines the expectations formerly carried by element_expectations.

cover_type.description: Cover sheet type letter for structure_detector routing

source_quality_score.description: I284: template-scoped cover source-quality map {cover_type: score}. Consumed by HealthScorer._score_source_quality for the source_quality dimension. Linked only to document_templates (no project override). When absent for a template, HealthScorer falls back to health_scoring.default_source_quality_scores in eks_doc_config.json.

expected_elements.description: Structural elements expected for structural completeness scoring

threshold.description: Minimum detected elements to pass structural completeness

structural_profile_def.description: I280 (T1.218): B3.2 Structural Characteristics profile. Declares the physical layout / visual elements expected for a document class or type. Used by type-aware StructureDetector (I283) to tailor element detection. Fields absent = default/unknown.

cover_page.description: Whether a cover page is expected (B2.1 Document Structure)

revision_table.description: Whether a revision table is expected

multi_sheet.description: Whether the document is typically multi-sheet

drawing_based.description: Whether content is drawing-based (graphics heavy) vs text-based

section_based.description: Whether content is organised into sections/headings

contains_callouts.description: Whether visual callouts/labels are expected (B2.1 Visual Elements)

extraction_profile_ref.description: I280 (T1.218): reference to an extraction_profiles id in eks_processing_config.json (I281 SSOT). Validated at runtime against the extraction_profiles registry.

retrieval_profile_ref.description: I280 (T1.218): reference to a retrieval_profiles id (Phase 2/3 — not yet populated; null/absent until then).

validation_profile_ref.description: I280 (T1.218): reference to a validation_profiles id (I284 feeds the column-value validation layer; container exists, values Phase 2/3).

document_semantics_def.description: I280 (T1.218): PHASE 3 STUB — B3.2 Document Semantics: what knowledge a document contains, directly feeding the graph database. Optional; no code consumers in Phase 1.

ai_profile_def.description: I280 (T1.218): PHASE 3 STUB — B3.2 AI Behaviour profile: how RAG/QA should reason over this document type. Optional; no code consumers in Phase 1.

knowledge_relationships_def.description: I280 (T1.218): PHASE 3 STUB — B3.2 Knowledge Relationships: typed relation registry for graph edges. Optional; no code consumers in Phase 1.

project_code.description: I290 (T1.253): engineering project code (e.g. 131101) — composite-FK partner for document_type→project_doc_type (project_code, local_code). Populated at ingest from the pipeline project context. Kept nullable for backward compatibility (documents can be registered before project context is known).

file_path.description: Relative path to source file on disk

file_type.description: Source file format for parser routing

file_size.description: OS-level file size in bytes (from Path.stat().st_size)

file_created_at.description: OS-level file creation timestamp (from st_ctime, UTC ISO 8601)

file_modified_at.description: OS-level file last-modified timestamp (from st_mtime, UTC ISO 8601)

file_hash.description: Content hash (MD5 or SHA256) for integrity verification

embedded_title.description: Embedded document title from parser metadata

embedded_subject.description: Embedded document subject from parser metadata

embedded_created_date.description: Embedded creation date from parser metadata

embedded_modified_date.description: Embedded modification date from parser metadata

embedded_creator_app.description: Application that created the file (e.g. AutoCAD 2024)

embedded_producer.description: Library/producer that generated the file (e.g. pdfplot15.hdi)

embedded_last_modified_by.description: Last user who modified the file (from DOCX/XLSX core properties)

embedded_sheet_count.description: Number of sheets in XLSX workbook

supersedes.description: FK to documents.id — the previous revision this document supersedes. T1.99.141.

superseded_by.description: FK to documents.id — the next revision that supersedes this document. T1.99.141.

revision_date.description: Date of this revision (ISO 8601 string). T1.99.143.

revision_description.description: Description of changes in this revision. T1.99.143.

embedded_revision_number.description: Revision number from embedded DOCX/XLSX core properties. T1.99.144.

references_documents.description: Array of doc_id strings this document references. T1.99.145.

project_phase.description: Project lifecycle phase (e.g. tender, construction, as_built). T1.99.146.

issued_date.description: Formal issue/submission date to client (ISO 8601 string). T1.99.146.

responsible_engineer.description: Engineer accountable for the document. T1.99.146.

total_sheets.description: Total sheets in multi-sheet drawing set. T1.99.146.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of document content. T1.99.146.

vendor_name.description: Equipment vendor name for vendor-supplied documents. T1.99.146.

document_element_def.description: Structural element extracted from a document (cover page, section, table, image, etc.) per Appendix D D7.10. I291 (T1.254): shape enriched — `id` UUID PK, `created_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), optional `element_seq`; FK SSOT `doc_id` → `documents.id` and `element_type` → `element_type.element_type` declared as declared_only relations in registry_relations (physical FK DDL not emitted per I290 precedent).

id.description: I291 (T1.254): surrogate UUID primary key, assigned at ingest (system-generated; not part of the required payload). Matches the documents table UUID PK pattern and is a declared_only FK target.

doc_id.description: I291 (T1.254): FK → documents.id (canonical registry UUID PK; SSOT per I291 Q2 — declared_only relation fk_element_doc). Formerly 'document_registry.doc_id'.

element_type.description: I291 (T1.254): FK → element_type.element_type (11-code enum; declared_only relation fk_element_type). Validated by DocumentRegistry.store_elements.

title.description: Heading, field name, or section title

content.description: Raw text or JSON for complex structures

created_at.description: I291 (T1.254): row creation timestamp; DDL emits TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now().

element_seq.description: I291 (T1.254): optional 0-based sequence of the element within its document for deterministic intra-document ordering.

registry_relation_def.description: I290 (T1.253): A single declared FK relationship on the runtime `documents` registry table (GROUP 11 in appendix_b.2_db_table_design.md). Declared as schema metadata (SSOT, AGENTS.md §16) and consumed by SchemaToDDL to persist `_eks_table_relations`; the runtime DuckDB registry does NOT emit physical FOREIGN KEY constraints to un-materialized definition-layer tables (DuckDB rejects FK referencing a missing table at DDL time and blocks PK updates on rows referenced by self-FKs during the UUID migration). One object per (source_columns → target_table(target_columns)).

source_columns.description: Column(s) on the source runtime table holding the FK value(s).

target_table.description: Referenced table name ('documents' for self-refs; definition-layer table name for declared-but-unmaterialized FKs).

target_columns.description: Referenced key column(s) on target_table (composite keys declared with 2 entries).

relation_type.description: composite = multi-column target key; self = targets the same 'documents' table.

declared_only.description: true = logical declaration only (definition layer not materialized in runtime DuckDB; enforced at validation layer); no physical DuckDB FK constraint is emitted.

document_registry_relations.description: I290 (T1.253): Ordered list of declared FK relationships for the runtime `documents` registry (GROUP 11). Consumed by SchemaToDDL.generate_documents_relations() and persisted to `_eks_table_relations` on registry init. All are declared_only — the definition-layer target tables (project_doc_type, discipline, file_type, project_definition) are NOT materialized in the runtime DuckDB registry, and self-FKs must be suppressed because DuckDB blocks PK updates referenced by self-FKs during `_migrate_ids_to_uuid`. Referential integrity is enforced by the validation layer (registry.register_document against COLUMN_ALLOWLIST + definition registries).

filename_segment_def.description: Single positional segment definition within a filename pattern (Appendix I §I4.4).

filename_output_def.description: Output control configuration for filename parsing (Appendix I §I4.5).

filename_error_subcodes_def.description: Maps error conditions to P5-F-* error codes (Appendix I §I4.2).

filename_pattern_def.description: Single filename pattern entry (Appendix I §I4.2). Keyed by project_code or '*' for default.

file_property_source_def.description: Single source-key-to-registry-column mapping for parser-embedded metadata (Appendix J §J2.1).

source_key.description: Key name in parser extract_metadata() return dict

required.description: Whether this property is required for health scoring

enabled.description: Master switch for OS-level property extraction

hash_algorithm.description: Hashing algorithm for file integrity check

enabled.description: Whether property extraction is enabled for this file type

extraction_method.description: parser_metadata = read embedded metadata from parser output; os_only = only Path.stat()

property_mapping.description: Mapping from parser extract_metadata() keys to registry columns

export_artifact_def.description: Defines the column subset for each export artifact (CSV/XLSX). Pipeline reads this at runtime instead of hardcoded column lists. T1.99.158 (I193).

discovery_inventory.description: Columns for Phase A discovery inventory. All x_export fields except extraction-specific ones (page_count, extract_status, extraction_confidence, extraction_notes).

extraction_results.description: Columns for Phase B extraction results. All x_export fields including extraction metadata.

review_flags.description: Columns for Phase C review flags. Focused subset for extraction-quality triage + computed flag_reason.

column_type_enum.description: Processing role classification for registry columns. Each type determines how the column value is processed, validated, and exported.

processing_phase_enum.description: Pipeline phase that populates this column. Phase A = filename parsing, Phase B = content parsing + metadata extraction, Phase C = review flagging, bootstrap = DDL-generated at registry creation.

calculation_strategy_def.description: Calculation strategy for derived columns. The 'type' determines which handler resolves this column; remaining properties are type-specific parameters.

type.description: Calculation handler type. Each type maps to a registered ColumnProcessor handler plugin.

source.description: Source identifier (e.g., cover_page_element, parser_metadata, code_to_title_lookup, existing_record)

field.description: Field name to read from the source

sources.description: Ordered list of sources for priority_chain resolution. First non-null value wins.

fallback.description: Fallback behavior when all sources return null.

position.description: Positional index for filename_segment calculation. Null when separator-based extraction is used (e.g. revision).

maps_to.description: Target column name for file_property or segment mapping.

field.description: Field name for parser_metadata or cover_page_element lookup.

handler_def.description: ColumnProcessor handler plugin class name. Overrides the default handler inferred from calculation.type. Registered plugins: PriorityChainResolver, FilenameSegmentResolver, FilePropertyResolver, MetadataResolver, CoverPageResolver, CodeToTitleResolver, HealthScoreResolver, AutoIncrementResolver.

validation_rule_def.description: Single validation rule applied to a column value. The 'type' determines which validator runs; remaining properties are rule-specific parameters.

reference.description: Schema reference name for enum_reference or schema_reference_check.

data_section.description: Section within the referenced schema (e.g., projects, document_types).

field.description: Field name within the schema section for enum matching.

description.description: Human-readable description of this validation rule.

column_processing_entry_def.description: Single column processing entry. Defines how a column is classified, calculated, validated, and which pipeline phase populates it.

is_calculated.description: Whether this column is derived (true) or populated from a source field (false).

calculation.description: Calculation strategy. Required if is_calculated is true.

handler.description: Handler plugin override. Optional — defaults to handler registered for calculation.type.

schema_ref.description: Reference to an external schema for cross-schema validation (e.g., project_code_schema, document_type_schema).

schema_ref_field.description: Field name within the referenced schema to validate against.

validation.description: Per-column validation rules applied after the value is resolved.

required.description: I284: whether this column is REQUIRED for the claimed document classes. required=true → a missing value scores 0 (penalises the health score). required=false → the column weight is 0 (neutral; missing value does not penalise).

scoring_tier.description: I284: health-score tier for this column. tier1=critical (weight from health_scoring.weight_tiers.tier1_critical), tier2=standard, tier3=optional, excluded=never scored. excluded takes precedence over required — an excluded column produces no score even if required=true.

applies_to_document_types.description: I284: REQUIRED. Array of class_ids (from document_classes) this column explicitly applies to — every data column must be explicitly claimed to each document class. Classes not listed are NOT scored for this column. The document's resolved class (local_code -> binding -> class_id) must be listed for the column to participate. I282: concept_id migrated to class_id.

native_only.description: I275: when true, this column can only populate when the resolved project binding's format_category is 'native' (dwg/dgn/docx/xlsx). Excluded for PDF-print delivery which lacks embedded metadata.

manual_review.description: I286: data-source classification flag. true = Manual-source column requiring human input (Appendix B §B4; surfaced in Phase 5 verification). false/absent = derivable column (from filename/file properties or pipeline). The flag is a classification, NOT a review gate — derivable columns remain review-allowed via the review workflow (confirmation a).

description.description: Human-readable description of this column and its processing.

registry_relations.description: I290 (T1.253): document_type resolves through the composite candidate key (project_code, local_code) on project_doc_type (Q1). Deferred: project_doc_type is a definition-layer table not materialized in the runtime DuckDB registry; declared schema metadata for validation + future materialization.

I290 (T1.253): self-ref FK supersedes→documents.id. Declared_only: DuckDB blocks PK UPDATEs of rows referenced by self-FK during _migrate_ids_to_uuid — suppressed at DDL, enforced by revision-link logic.
I290 (T1.253): self-ref reverse link; same declared_only rationale as fk_supersedes.
I290 (T1.253): registry project_code FK to project_definition (GROUP 9); declared-only (target unmaterialized).
I290 (T1.253): registry discipline FK (GROUP 1 reference); declared-only.
I290 (T1.253): registry file_type FK to file_type.extension (GROUP 6, 5 rows); declared-only.

I291 (T1.254): document_elements.doc_id FK → documents.id (registry UUID PK; SSOT per I291 Q2). declared_only — a physical DuckDB FK here would block _migrate_ids_to_uuid PK UPDATEs (I290 precedent); enforced by store_elements doc_id existence check.

I291 (T1.254): document_elements.element_type FK → element_type.element_type (GROUP 3, 11 codes). declared_only — element_type is a definition-layer table not materialized in the runtime DuckDB registry; enforced by store_elements 11-code enum validation.
